pictures.name: QW1-Boat-Shore
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. The shore of the Sea of Galilee in soft morning light. A great crowd of villagers stands and sits along the pebbly beach and the grassy slope. Just off shore, Jesus, a man in a plain off-white robe with a soft brown mantle, shown ONLY from behind or as a far figure, his face never visible, sits in a wooden fishing boat, seen from behind, facing the crowd, one hand raised as he speaks. Calm water, gentle light.

pictures.name: QW2-Sower-Throws
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A hillside field in Galilee in early morning light. a sun-browned Galilean farmer in his fifties with a grey beard, a sweat-darkened tan tunic and a cloth seed bag slung over one shoulder, strides through the field flinging seed in a wide golden arc from his hand, seed scattering everywhere, onto the earth, a footpath, rocks and the edges of thorn bushes. Birds circle overhead. Generous, joyful motion.

pictures.name: QW3-Path-And-Rock
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. The edge of the same field: on a hard trodden footpath, sparrows peck up scattered seed; just beyond, on thin soil over pale rock, small green sprouts are already wilting and browning under a hot sun. Close and detailed. Loss.

pictures.name: QW5-Harvest
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. The same hillside field at harvest: a sea of tall golden wheat, heavy heads bending, glowing in late-afternoon light. a sun-browned Galilean farmer in his fifties with a grey beard, a sweat-darkened tan tunic and a cloth seed bag slung over one shoulder, stands in the middle of it, up to his chest in grain, one hand running over the heads, amazed and smiling. pictures.name: QW6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern school hallway at the end of the day. A teacher in a cardigan tucks a small handwritten note of encouragement into a student’s locker door, smiling, students walking past in the background. Warm afternoon light through windows. Quiet hope sown.
